note: Every catalogue strategy ever defined. Never remove entries.

strategies.name: cat_turtle_s1_d1
strategies.title: Turtle System 1 (20/10-day Donchian)
strategies.source: Curtis Faith, 'Way of the Turtle' (2007)
strategies.logic: Buy when gold makes a new 20-day high and sell when it makes a new 20-day low; get out on a 10-day break the other way.
strategies.entry: Long when the daily close is above the highest high of the prior 20 days; short when below the lowest low of the prior 20 days.
strategies.exit: Exit long when the close is below the prior 10-day low; exit short when above the prior 10-day high; an opposite entry also reverses.
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe from the entry close.

strategies.name: cat_turtle_s2_d1
strategies.title: Turtle System 2 (55/20-day Donchian)
strategies.source: Curtis Faith, 'Way of the Turtle' (2007)
strategies.logic: Buy a new 55-day high and sell a new 55-day low; exit on a 20-day break the other way.
strategies.entry: Long when the daily close is above the prior 55-day high; short when below the prior 55-day low.
strategies.exit: Exit long below the prior 20-day low; exit short above the prior 20-day high; an opposite entry reverses.
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_donchian20_h4
strategies.title: Donchian 20/10 on H4
strategies.source: Richard Donchian's channel rule, as popularised by the Turtles; H4 application is common in retail gold systems
strategies.logic: The 20/10 channel breakout, faster, on four-hour bars.
strategies.entry: Long when the H4 close is above the prior 20-bar high; short when below the prior 20-bar low.
strategies.exit: Exit long below the prior 10-bar low; exit short above the prior 10-bar high; opposite entry reverses.
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_golden_cross_d1
strategies.title: Golden/death cross (50/200-day SMA)
strategies.source: Classic chart rule; e.g. Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron, Journal of Finance 47(5), 1992
strategies.logic: Hold gold long after the 50-day average crosses above the 200-day, and short after it crosses below.
strategies.entry: Long on the day the 50-day SMA crosses above the 200-day SMA; short on the day it crosses below.
strategies.exit: The opposite cross reverses the position; no other exit.
strategies.stop: 4 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe, a catastrophic stop only (the classic rule has none); after a stop-out it waits for the next cross.

strategies.name: cat_ema_cross_h1
strategies.title: EMA 20/50 cross on H1
strategies.source: Common retail moving-average crossover system
strategies.logic: Follow the hourly 20/50 EMA cross.
strategies.entry: Long when EMA(20) crosses above EMA(50); short when it crosses below.
strategies.exit: Opposite cross reverses.
strategies.stop: 3 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_faber_10m_mn1
strategies.title: Faber 10-month SMA timing
strategies.source: Mebane Faber, 'A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation' (2007), https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=962461
strategies.logic: Own gold only while its monthly close is above the 10-month moving average.
strategies.entry: Long at any monthly close above the 10-month SMA of monthly closes (so it re-enters the month after a stop-out if still above).
strategies.exit: Exit when a monthly close is below the 10-month SMA. Long only.
strategies.stop: 4 x the monthly ATR(14), catastrophic only.

strategies.name: cat_tsmom_12m_d1
strategies.title: Time-series momentum (12-month, monthly rebalance)
strategies.source: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen, 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104(2), 2012, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.11.003
strategies.logic: Be long gold if it is up over the past year and short if it is down, checking once a month.
strategies.entry: On the first trading day of each month: long if close / close 252 days ago - 1 > 0, short if < 0.
strategies.exit: Reverses on a later monthly check with the opposite sign; otherwise holds.
strategies.stop: 4 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe, catastrophic; re-entry only at the next monthly check.

strategies.name: cat_keltner_breakout_h1
strategies.title: Keltner channel breakout (EMA20 +/- 2 ATR)
strategies.source: Chester Keltner (1960); ATR form popularised by Linda Bradford Raschke
strategies.logic: A close outside the ATR channel starts a trend trade that lasts until price returns to the average.
strategies.entry: Long when the close crosses above EMA(20) + 2 x ATR(14); short when it crosses below EMA(20) - 2 x ATR(14).
strategies.exit: Exit long when the close is below EMA(20); exit short when above EMA(20).
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_bollinger_breakout_h4
strategies.title: Bollinger band breakout on H4
strategies.source: John Bollinger, 'Bollinger on Bollinger Bands' (2001)
strategies.logic: A close outside the bands is treated as the start of a move.
strategies.entry: Long when the H4 close crosses above the upper band (SMA20 + 2 SD); short when it crosses below the lower band.
strategies.exit: Exit long when the close is below the 20-bar SMA; exit short when above it.
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_di_cross_h1
strategies.title: Wilder DI cross with ADX > 25
strategies.source: J. Welles Wilder, 'New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems' (1978)
strategies.logic: When +DI crosses above -DI in a trending market, buy; the reverse, sell.
strategies.entry: Long when +DI(14) crosses above -DI(14) and ADX(14) > 25; short when -DI crosses above +DI and ADX > 25.
strategies.exit: Exit on the opposite DI cross (regardless of ADX).
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_supertrend_h1
strategies.title: Supertrend (10, 3)
strategies.source: Olivier Seban's Supertrend indicator; standard definition as in most charting packages
strategies.logic: Follow the Supertrend's direction, reversing when it flips.
strategies.entry: Long on the bar the Supertrend (ATR 10, multiplier 3, on (high+low)/2) flips up; short when it flips down.
strategies.exit: The opposite flip reverses.
strategies.stop: Distance from the entry close to the Supertrend line, at least 0.5 x ATR(14).

strategies.name: cat_macd_zero_h4
strategies.title: MACD signal cross with zero-line filter
strategies.source: Gerald Appel, 'Technical Analysis: Power Tools for Active Investors' (2005)
strategies.logic: Buy MACD bullish crosses only when MACD is above zero, and sell bearish crosses only below zero.
strategies.entry: Long when MACD(12,26) crosses above its 9-EMA signal while MACD > 0; short when it crosses below while MACD < 0.
strategies.exit: Exit long on any bearish signal cross; exit short on any bullish cross.
strategies.stop: 2.5 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_ichimoku_h4
strategies.title: Ichimoku cloud break with TK alignment
strategies.source: Goichi Hosoda's Ichimoku Kinko Hyo; standard 9/26/52 settings
strategies.logic: Price above the cloud with the fast line above the slow line is an uptrend; the reverse a downtrend.
strategies.entry: Long on the first bar where the close is above both cloud spans (each shifted 26 bars) and Tenkan(9) > Kijun(26); short mirrored.
strategies.exit: Exit long when the close is below Kijun; exit short when above.
strategies.stop: 2.5 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_52w_high_d1
strategies.title: 52-week closing-high breakout
strategies.source: Adapted from George and Hwang, 'The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing', Journal of Finance 59(5), 2004 (stocks)
strategies.logic: New yearly highs tend to keep going, so buy them and hold until the trend weakens.
strategies.entry: Long when the daily close crosses above the highest close of the prior 252 days. Long only.
strategies.exit: Exit when the close is below the 50-day SMA.
strategies.stop: 3 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_nr7_d1
strategies.title: NR7 breakout
strategies.source: Toby Crabel, 'Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and Opening Range Breakout' (1990)
strategies.logic: Very narrow days come before expansion; trade the direction of the break.
strategies.entry: If yesterday's high-low range was the smallest of the last 7 days: long when today's close is above yesterday's high, short when below yesterday's low.
strategies.exit: Exit after 5 days.
strategies.stop: The far side of the NR7 day's range (its low for a long, its high for a short).

strategies.name: cat_inside_bar_h4
strategies.title: Inside-bar breakout on H4
strategies.source: Common price-action pattern, e.g. Al Brooks, 'Trading Price Action Trends' (2011)
strategies.logic: A bar inside the previous bar is a pause; the break of the bigger bar shows direction.
strategies.entry: If the previous bar was inside the bar before it: long when the close is above the mother bar's high, short when below its low.
strategies.exit: Target 1 x the mother bar's range from entry; otherwise exit after 12 bars.
strategies.stop: The mother bar's opposite extreme.

strategies.name: cat_dual_thrust_h1
strategies.title: Dual Thrust (4-day range, k = 0.5)
strategies.source: Michael Chalek's Dual Thrust system, widely published in futures-system literature
strategies.logic: Buy when price moves half a recent range above the day's open, sell the mirror, and close everything late in the day.
strategies.entry: Range = max(HH - LC, HC - LL) over the prior 4 COMEX days. Long on the first H1 close above day open + 0.5 x Range; short on the first close below open - 0.5 x Range; no new entries from 15:00 New York.
strategies.exit: Flat at the first bar from 16:00 New York; an opposite entry reverses.
strategies.stop: 0.5 x Range (back to the day's open).

strategies.name: cat_chandelier_h4
strategies.title: 20-bar breakout with chandelier exit
strategies.source: Chuck LeBeau's chandelier exit, as described in Alexander Elder, 'Come into My Trading Room' (2002)
strategies.logic: Enter breakouts and let a trailing stop hung from the recent high decide the exit.
strategies.entry: Long when the H4 close is above the prior 20-bar high; short when below the prior 20-bar low.
strategies.exit: Exit long when the close is below the highest high of the last 22 bars - 3 x ATR(14); short mirrored.
strategies.stop: 3 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_ema_pullback_h1
strategies.title: Pullback to EMA20 in an aligned trend
strategies.source: Common trend-pullback rule; own exact parameters
strategies.logic: In a clean uptrend, a touch of the 20-EMA that closes back above it is a chance to join the trend.
strategies.entry: Long when EMA20 > EMA50 > SMA200, the bar's low touches EMA20, and the bar closes above EMA20 and above its open; short mirrored.
strategies.exit: Target 3 x ATR(14); otherwise exit after 48 bars.
strategies.stop: 1.5 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.

strategies.name: cat_weekly_breakout_h4
strategies.title: Prior-week high/low breakout
strategies.source: Own idea, a weekly variant of the channel breakout
strategies.logic: Breaking last week's range shows a new weekly trend.
strategies.entry: Long on the first H4 close of the week above the previous calendar week's (UTC) high; short on the first close below its low.
strategies.exit: Exit after 30 H4 bars (about a week); an opposite entry reverses.
strategies.stop: 2 x the project's Wilder ATR(14) on the signal timeframe.
